title: Employment Situation (Aug 2027 data) — 08:30 ET, the last payroll before the September SEP meeting and the quietest print day of the year
source: EST: derived from BLS's own published scheduling rule — the Employment Situation is released on the third Friday following the end of the reference week (the Sun-Sat week containing the 12th). THE RULE WAS RE-IMPLEMENTED AND RE-VALIDATED FROM SCRATCH BY THIS EVENT'S OWN never-assessed RESEARCH (2026-09-09) rather than inherited from the proposal: 7 for 7 against the four confirmed jobs-* entries on this calendar (2026-09-04, 2026-10-02, 2026-11-06, 2026-12-04) and the three historical Sunday-July-4 releases (2004-07-02, 2010-07-02, 2021-07-02). For August 2027 the reference week is Sun 2027-08-08 to Sat 2027-08-14, and the third Friday after 08-14 is 2027-09-03, an ordinary NYSE trading day; the rule's one documented failure mode is a holiday landing on the rule's own Friday, and the nearest holiday here is Labor Day on Mon 2027-09-06, which FOLLOWS the print and never displaces it. The prefix is EST: and not BLS: because bls.gov returned HTTP 403 to a browser user-agent on all four schedule routes re-tried on 2026-09-09 (/schedule/news_release/2027_sched.htm, /schedule/news_release/empsit.htm, /schedule/home.htm, /bls/news-release/empsit.htm) and fred.stlouisfed.org/release/dates?rid=50 failed to connect at all — all five recorded in this event's probe-ref.blocked. A derived date is not a published one
notes: CANONICAL FILE WRITTEN BY THIS EVENT'S OWN never-assessed RESEARCH (2026-09-09), superseding proposals/jobs-2027-09-03.from-jobs-2027-08-06.json, which stays where it is and is now shadowed. WHAT THIS SESSION ESTABLISHED THAT THE PROPOSAL DID NOT. (1) THE SIBLING'S HEADLINE INSTRUCTION DOES NOT TRANSFER TO THIS DATE. jobs-2027-08-06 measured August as the year's most bond-dominated payroll (amplification rank 1 of 12 in TLT/IEF/AGG) and told a reader to size duration paper for roughly twice an ordinary session. Re-run here on the same Yahoo split/dividend-adjusted bars 1993-2026, SEPTEMBER is the opposite profile: amplification ranks 11/12 for SPY (0.86x), 12/12 for QQQ (0.75x -- the payroll session moves QQQ LESS than an ordinary September session), 11/12 for IEF (1.26x) and 9/12 for AGG (1.47x), with only TLT (1.55x, rank 5) and LQD (1.52x, rank 6) mid-pack. Two consecutive payrolls, opposite seasonal profiles; the August instruction is month-keyed and must not be carried forward. (2) THE RISK IS NOT THE 08:30 PRINT, IT IS THE OVERNIGHT GAP FOUR DAYS LATER, AND THAT IS NEW. The 20 pre-Labor-Day September payrolls 1993-2026 replicate jobs-2027-07-02's long-weekend reopen lift on their own, without the 5 July-2 prints that lane pooled in (TLT 1.79x p=0.025, LQD 2.17x p=0.0032, AGG 1.84x p=0.044, IEF 1.61x p=0.060, ^VIX 1.90x p=0.012) -- and DECOMPOSED for the first time, the lift is entirely the weekend GAP, never the reopen session: gap TLT 2.11x (p=0.0057), AGG 1.88x (0.031), LQD 1.77x (0.030), IEF 1.76x (0.030), ^VIX 1.39x (0.034), all five significant, while not one reopen-SESSION leg clears (every p >= 0.078). The corollary base rate: after an ordinary payroll the reopen out-moves the print only 32-40% of the time (p < 0.0001 in all five instruments); after a pre-Labor-Day payroll it is 50-71%. (3) THE FOMC-ADJACENT FRAMINGS ARE BOTH EMPTY. The sibling already refuted days-to-decision over 392 releases and that is cited, not re-run. What is refuted HERE is the different mechanism this date invites -- the print lands the day before fomc-blackout-start-2027-09-04, so no Fed official may publicly react to it: September payrolls whose blackout opens at D+1 (n=11) versus D+8 (n=13), print-day |move| and forward 10-session realized vol across six instruments, 12 tests, ONE nominal hit (AGG fwd RV p=0.044) which is exactly the false-positive count 12 tests at alpha=0.05 produce and reproduces nowhere. (4) A NEIGHBOUR'S FACT IS TRUE AND ITS NATURAL INFERENCE IS FALSE. fomc-blackout-start-2027-09-04 established that September 2027 is the only second-Tuesday September FOMC in 2007-2027 -- reproduced independently here (16 of 19 Tuesday-starts are third-Tuesday) -- but the pulled-forward corridor does NOT make this payroll's geometry unusual: the payroll-to-blackout gap is +1 day in 11 of the 26 Septembers 2000-2026, including each of 2024, 2025 and 2026. Unique meeting, ordinary payroll placement. (5) UNLIKE THE SIBLING, THIS PRINT IS NOT ALONE: consumer-confidence-2027-08-31 and fhfa-hpi-2027-08-31 at D-3, fomc-blackout-start-2027-09-04 at D+1, labor-day-market-closure-2027-09-06 at D+3, then fomc-2027-09-15 and vix-expiration-2027-09-15 at D+12 and opex-2027-09-17 at D+14. (6) STRUCTURE, from federalreserve.gov's own 2027 calendar re-fetched this session (HTTP 200, page-stated 'Last Update: August 19, 2026'): this is the LAST payroll before the September 14-15* SEP meeting -- the next release by the same rule is 2027-10-08, proposed in this PR -- and the second of exactly the two payrolls that meeting sees, the first being jobs-2027-08-06. HONEST LIMITS. STATUS IS ESTIMATE AND MUST STAY THERE until bls.gov's 2027 schedule is actually retrieved; promotion trigger is any successful fetch of it naming this date, which flips the prefix to BLS: and the status to confirmed. impact high and symbols [] match every other jobs-* entry.
